caption: Pearson correlations between each Cass Freight signal lagged L months and the SPY 1-month forward return. Cells are small at nearly every lead and the few starred ones are scattered and flip sign across transforms — the signature of a coincident series with no stable predictive lead. The winner's own signal (trend deviation) carries no stable forward correlation at any measured lead (near-zero, slightly negative at L9–L12); its deployed lead L13 sits beyond this 0–12 view, at the very ceiling of the floored grid — which is why L13 is best read as a likely search artifact (issue #28).
narrative_alignment_note: Honest near-null lead view; winner signal 'trend deviation' has no stable predictive lead; L13 is the grid ceiling.
